verdict.rationale: Babylon.js core is a fully open-source (Apache-2.0), npm-distributed library that runs entirely client-side or server-side (via NullEngine) with no vendor SaaS dependency, confirmed by runtime probe (npm version, license) and docs on server-side support and NPM/ES6 module packaging. missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting deployment guide/tutorial, and no independent hands-on report of someone self-hosting the full toolchain (Playground/Inspector/NME are hosted separately) in the evidence.
